translations.web: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
translations.bsb: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
translations.kjv: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
